name: Longsword
description: Hand-and-a-half, well balanced, and honest about its price. It prefers to be drawn on purpose.
notes: A fine sword; reuses the arming sword move set (no longer reach or heft modelled yet). Catalogue tier fine (economy doc, swords 60-140 x2.5). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
